text:
Alex: Quick midweek pulse — kernel queue priming + KV warmup perf. Short check: what I did / blockers / today. Ping if you need details.

Alex: Did: landed microbatch slotting fix (PR https://git.redwood/PR/482) — reduced slot steal in local bench. p95 went from ~112ms -> ~89ms on synthetic mix. :tada:

Alex: Blocker: seeing a KV cold-hit spike on shard-12 after long idle. Can repro with harness `scripts/kv-replay --shard 12 --seed 42`. Looks like eviction threshold might be too aggressive on that shard.

Mira: Thanks. I saw the same pattern on canary last night. I pushed an evict-threshold tweak to my branch and started a smoke run. @Alex can you paste the exact bench command you used?

Alex: Sure — `./bench/run --model gpt-small --seq 512 --concurrency 8 --duration 300` plus `--kv-cache=true`. I primed prefixes with the standard priming set (same as warmup job).

Sam: Today: I will wire eviction metrics into the traces dashboard (per-route eviction_count histogram) and add a test that simulates long idle + sudden burst. Should help correlate requests -> evictions.

Priya: Heads up: I'm drafting a rollback playbook in case the priming fix regresses memory on Dedicated pools. Need to validate cold-start TFs and mem baselines first.

Jordan: Quick question: we tried bumping default `batch_wait_ms` from 2 -> 4 in a micro-canary; throughput improved but median latency +6ms. Do we want to change defaults or expose as pool-level policy?

Alex: Prefer pool-level policy rather than global default for now. @Mira @Sam can you run a controlled A/B (default vs 4ms) with the same traffic shape and kv-warmup enabled? Capture p50/p95/p99 + cpu/gpu UTIL.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy: kernel/slot-fix-482 deployed to canary-group-3 at 2026-03-18T09:12:11Z :rocket:

Mira: On it — kicking off A/B + long-idle rehearse against shard-12 repro. Will post numbers and flamegraphs in ~2 hrs.

Sam: Added evict histogram to /observability/routes/kernel/warmup and started a small dashboard PR (coming).

Alex: Thanks all. If someone hits a quick repro, drop logs here (export with `scripts/export-evict-logs --shard 12`). I'll triage shard mapping and share a tiny mapping script to correlate evictions -> request ids.
